objective: Adopt the rule that a ladder increment may not be published as a FEATURE without draw-scatter evidence at the rung it turns on, or with the absence of that evidence stated on its face; and price the retrofit of every stored ladder that lacks it
rationale: Every ladder in this lab that has ever had replicate meshes drawn at a rung has returned a material finding, and the count is four for four. B-52: the published turn of -4.055e-3 turned out to be max(rung 6) minus min(rung 7) of eight same-recipe draws, re-estimating to +8.2e-5 +/- 1.2e-3 with the sign flipped, and the turn is WITHDRAWN as a claim (chief ruling 7abb0ba3). NACA 0012: three of four meshes built to the same recipe at the graded resolution land inside the reference band and the PUBLISHED mesh is the family maximum at plus 1.35 sigma, so the row published a fail from the one draw in four that fails. NACA 4412: a three-rung replicate sweep measured construction scatter at 5.82, 12.74 and 4.20 percent of the mean, not monotone, with the graded rung the worst of the three. Ahmed 25: one same-recipe redraw at the turn's previously untested lower end moves Cd by 6.6x the increment and flips its sign, and the claim is under active test at n=2 of a planned 4. THE CHECK HAS NEVER ONCE COME BACK CLEAN. Nothing in the corpus is presently wrong -- every stored study reads conclusive false and none publishes a reportable band -- but nothing is presently checked either, and the two families that were checked have had their headline features withdrawn or put under test. The defect is structural rather than local: uq.eca_hoekstra_band cannot infer draw scatter from a cell-count and value series, so a ladder can be fitted, banded and quoted without anyone ever asking whether its increments exceed the scatter of the meshes they are differences of. The rule does not forbid publishing a ladder; it forbids publishing an increment as a FEATURE -- a turn, an oscillation, a divergence, a trend in increments -- while the scatter at the rung that feature turns on is unmeasured, unless the absence is stated where the feature is stated.
gate: Adopted only with the archive replay on the record, per the charter: replayed against every stored ladder and every campaign record that states a ladder feature, with counts recorded BEFORE adoption -- how many records state a feature, how many of those have draw-scatter evidence at the deciding rung, and how many would be restated rather than withdrawn. Prediction, written before the replay: a minority of records fire, they are the ones stating a turn or an oscillation rather than a monotone trend, and the retrofit is cheaper than the two checks already run. A rule that fires on every record or on none fails its own entry condition and is not adopted. Separately, the retrofit is priced per ladder and offered as a menu, not a mandate: the price is the point of the filing, since it tells the lab what its unchecked ladders would cost to check
cost_basis: MEASURED, from this family's own two replicate campaigns, and stated as a band because two bodies disagree by a factor of 1.7 on cost per cell. Per-draw cost per 1000 cells: Ahmed c3 3.9 core-min at 254,911 cells on 4 ranks = 0.0153; B-52 rung 6 8.6 core-min at 330,950 cells on 2 ranks = 0.0260. Retrofit = 2 new draws at the turn rung (n=1 -> n=3, the minimum that yields a sample sd) for each unchecked ladder. SCOPE, corrected by recounting rather than re-reading: 12 stored studies, but 4 carry no ladder at all (airliner-wing, aortic-valve, tmr_flatplate_fine, tmr_flatplate_modelform have zero rungs), so 8 real ladders, of which 3 already carry draw evidence -- the retrofit scope is FIVE ladders, not the nine an earlier sweep of mine reported. Per ladder: ahmed_25 1.4-2.4, ahmed_35 1.4-2.4, motorBike 2.0-3.4, cube 3.2-5.4, naca0015_sail 4.8-8.1. TOTAL 12.8-21.7 core-min. est_core_min carries the upper bound because a floor recorded as an estimate manufactures false confidence
expected_knowledge_gain: The whole corpus's ladder features either gain a measured scatter or gain a stated absence, at a total price BELOW what checking the B-52 alone cost (40.9 core-min, which ended in a withdrawal). Either a minority of features are draw-sensitive and the wall gains a rule that stops one mesh from deciding a published shape, or most are and the finding is that the lab's ladder layer is under-replicated as a class -- which resets the replicate budget before the next ladder is fitted
